Miguel (Support): FYI escalating MediStream onboarding — dedicated provisioning stuck, customer can't finish capacity setup and trial renewal is 30 days out. Need CS comms + short-term remediation. :exclamation:
Sara (CS): On it. Quick Q: how many seats/throughput did they request? need that for tiering and SLA fallback. Can you paste the error? @Kei heads-up.
Kei (CSM): MediStream is in pilot, confirmed 5-node equivalent expected, POC KPIs are latency < 120ms. Renewal conversation starts in ~30 days but this is a huge blocker for adoption. If provision doesn't land in 48h we should flag renewal risk.
Miguel (Support): Error from provisioner: `vpc-peering-failed: CIDR_CONFLICT` — their infra team used overlapping CIDRs with our recommended VPC. Tried re-run and create with alternate cidr, provisioning job still hangs at 30%. Logs below:
```
2026-01-01T15:04:02Z provisioning: start job job-8731
2026-01-01T15:04:09Z networking: attempt vpc-peering to customer-vpc (10.10.0.0/16)
2026-01-01T15:04:09Z networking:error vpc-peering-failed: CIDR_OVERLAP with existing peer 10.10.0.0/16
2026-01-01T15:04:09Z provisioning: job-8731 status=waiting retry=3
```
Miguel (Support): Also tried temp fix: created hosted fallback route and gave them signed URL for API but data policy requires VPC for PII — they won't accept hosted route unless we journal encryption keys to their KMS.
Aisha (Solutions): We can offer a temporary compromise: host in our dedicated hosted lane but use customer KMS via JWT auth and strict logging redaction — reduces friction while infra teams sort VPC CIDR. I'll DM infra contact doc. Quick snippet to request customer KMS grant:
```
POST /kms/grant HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
{ "customer_id":"medistream-42", "key_id":"projects/medistream/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/rdw-key" }
```
Sara (CS): Comms plan proposal (quick bullets):
• Immediate - Send exec-level note to customer (Kei + Miguel to draft) explaining workaround and timeline.
• 6 hours - Support to confirm workaround feasibility with infra (Aisha + Miguel).
• 24 hours - If workaround OK, enable hosted-KMS fallback and schedule enablement session. Offer 30-day trial extension.
• 48 hours - If no progress on VPC, schedule small leadership sync and open renewal-risk flag.
Kei (CSM): I can draft the exec note, include these datapoints: expected throughput, POC impact, and ask for a named infra owner. I'll copy legal for the trial extension wording.
Miguel (Support): Assigning next steps: 1) Aisha to confirm KMS feasibility with infra (due in 6h). 2) Miguel to prepare host-fallback signed URL and minimal config (due 3h). 3) Kei to draft exec note and trial extension language (due 6h). 4) Sara to prepare renewal-risk ribbon if >48h (owner: Sara).
Aisha (Solutions): Confirmed — starting KMS check now, ETA 4h. If we need to run a short enablement, I can run a 45m session tomorrow.
DevOps Bot: deploy-provisioner job-8731 requeued by support at 2026-01-01T19:05:10Z (requester: miguel).
Sara (CS): Thanks team. Kei — once you post the exec note I'll push to account stakeholders and CS exec. Miguel — keep me posted on host-fallback readiness. I'll block a slot for the leadership sync on Monday at 10am PT as backup. :thumbsup:
